listen_ip.description: IP address TinyProxy binds to. Use 0.0.0.0 to listen on all interfaces (not recommended for public exposure).

port.description: TCP port for incoming proxy requests.

hostname.description: Optional hostname override. If empty, system hostname is used.

log_level.description: Logging verbosity. 'Info' or 'Notice' recommended for production.

log_file.description: Path to log file. Use '/dev/stdout' to log to standard output (e.g., systemd).

max_clients.description: Maximum concurrent client connections. Increase for high-traffic deployments.

min_spare_servers.description: Minimum idle child processes to keep ready for new requests.

max_spare_servers.description: Maximum idle child processes before terminating some.

start_servers.description: Number of child processes to spawn at startup.

timeout.description: Connection and request timeout in seconds. 600 = 10 minutes.

reverse_proxy.description: Enable reverse proxy mode (not typical for general-purpose proxy servers).

transparent.description: Run in transparent mode — does not add Via header. Use only for local network transparency.

access_rules.description: List of IP access control rules. Order matters: first match wins.

auth_enabled.description: Enable basic HTTP authentication. If true, TinyProxy will require username/password in requests.

upstream_proxies.description: Chain proxy configuration. Useful if upstream network requires a proxy.

no_proxy.description: Domains or IPs to bypass the proxy and connect directly to.

user_agent.description: Custom User-Agent header. Empty uses TinyProxy default (e.g., 'TinyProxy/1.10.0'.)
